title: Outcome Evidence Packet, Alternative Explanation And Counterfactual Design Registry
scope: Thirty-two empty outcome-evidence packets, eight empty alternative-explanation registers, and eight inactive counterfactual-design dockets for the Phase 71 panel and claim layer.
interpretation_boundary: A packet contract is not an eligible panel or proposed claim. A claim class is an evidence ceiling, not a publication decision. An alternative-explanation category is not an assessed explanation. A design family is not a registered counterfactual, and no descriptive change may be upgraded to attribution or causation automatically.

claim_class_taxonomy.label: Structural status
claim_class_taxonomy.boundary: Describes the existence, stage, authority, or workflow state of a record. It is not an operating outcome.

claim_class_taxonomy.label: Same-entity descriptive level
claim_class_taxonomy.boundary: Reports one reviewed level under one exact entity, measure, period, method, and denominator contract.

claim_class_taxonomy.label: Same-entity descriptive change
claim_class_taxonomy.boundary: Reports a reviewed within-entity direction and magnitude across compatible periods without attribution.

claim_class_taxonomy.label: Target attainment
claim_class_taxonomy.boundary: Compares a reviewed same-entity result with one explicit target whose authority, definition, period, and threshold are compatible.

claim_class_taxonomy.label: Association
claim_class_taxonomy.boundary: Reports a bounded relationship without claiming contribution, attribution, or causation.

claim_class_taxonomy.label: Contribution or attribution
claim_class_taxonomy.boundary: Requires a named intervention boundary, alternative-explanation assessment, defensible comparison basis, and explicit limits.

claim_class_taxonomy.label: Causal effect
claim_class_taxonomy.boundary: Requires a registered counterfactual design, estimand, identification assumptions, robustness tests, and separate human authorization.

outcome_packet_dimensions.label: Eligible panel and complete lineage
outcome_packet_dimensions.question: The packet resolves to one Phase 71 panel backed by an admitted series, accepted observations, revisions, breaks, and receipts.

outcome_packet_dimensions.label: Exact outcome question
outcome_packet_dimensions.question: The entity, population, measure, period, receiving system, and decision use are explicit.

outcome_packet_dimensions.label: Claim class and verb strength
outcome_packet_dimensions.question: The proposed language stays within one declared Phase 72 claim class and its evidence ceiling.

outcome_packet_dimensions.label: Direction, magnitude, and calculation
outcome_packet_dimensions.question: Every value, transformation, direction, magnitude, and rate is reproducible from admitted points.

outcome_packet_dimensions.label: Baseline, follow-up, and timing
outcome_packet_dimensions.question: Baseline, follow-up, cadence, lag, exposure window, partial periods, and temporal ordering are explicit.

outcome_packet_dimensions.label: Missingness, breaks, and revisions
outcome_packet_dimensions.question: Missing periods, method changes, corrections, restatements, segmentations, and bridges remain visible.

outcome_packet_dimensions.label: Adverse and disconfirming evidence
outcome_packet_dimensions.question: Failures, outages, reversals, exclusions, rejected units, and disconfirming observations remain in the packet.

outcome_packet_dimensions.label: Alternative-explanation inventory
outcome_packet_dimensions.question: Every applicable Phase 72 alternative category has evidence for, evidence against, uncertainty, and an adjudicated disposition.

outcome_packet_dimensions.label: Actor, intervention, and receiving boundary
outcome_packet_dimensions.question: The responsible actor, intervention, receiving authority, spillover risk, and no-transfer boundary are explicit.

outcome_packet_dimensions.label: Uncertainty and sensitivity
outcome_packet_dimensions.question: Coverage, measurement uncertainty, sampling or model uncertainty, and sensitivity to definitions and assumptions are explicit.

outcome_packet_dimensions.label: Reproducible artifact bundle
outcome_packet_dimensions.question: Public inputs, versions, calculations, exclusions, provenance, and a durable result snapshot can be independently inspected.

outcome_packet_dimensions.label: Dual review, receipt, and propagation
outcome_packet_dimensions.question: Two authorized reviewers decide the bounded language and complete every assigned reader-surface update.

alternative_explanation_categories.label: Market, demand, price, or macroeconomic change
Workforce, skills, staffing, or learning effects
Utility, infrastructure, logistics, or receiving-system change
Measurement, method, definition, or reporting change
Selection, composition, survivorship, or denominator change
Weather, incident, disruption, seasonality, or other external event

counterfactual_design_gates.label: Causal question and intervention
counterfactual_design_gates.question: The intervention, alternative, timing, mechanism, and causal question are explicit.

counterfactual_design_gates.label: Treatment unit and population
counterfactual_design_gates.question: Treatment unit, eligible population, inclusion rules, assignment level, and analysis level are explicit.

counterfactual_design_gates.label: Outcome and estimand
counterfactual_design_gates.question: The exact outcome, contrast, population, period, and causal estimand are declared before analysis.

counterfactual_design_gates.label: Baseline and pre-period
counterfactual_design_gates.question: Pre-intervention coverage can assess trends, seasonality, shocks, and design assumptions.

counterfactual_design_gates.label: Comparison or control construction
counterfactual_design_gates.question: Control eligibility, matching variables, donor pool, assignment mechanism, and exclusions are inspectable.

counterfactual_design_gates.label: Identification assumptions
counterfactual_design_gates.question: Randomization, exchangeability, parallel trends, continuity, exclusion, or other identifying assumptions are testable and explicit.

counterfactual_design_gates.label: Interference and spillovers
counterfactual_design_gates.question: Contamination, displacement, network effects, concurrent exposure, and treatment-version variation are addressed.

counterfactual_design_gates.label: Confounding and selection
counterfactual_design_gates.question: Observed and plausible unobserved confounding, selection, composition, and treatment timing are addressed.

counterfactual_design_gates.label: Missing data and attrition
counterfactual_design_gates.question: Missing outcomes, censoring, attrition, revisions, and differential observation are visible and handled prospectively.

counterfactual_design_gates.label: Robustness and falsification
counterfactual_design_gates.question: Placebos, negative controls, pre-trend checks, alternate specifications, and failure thresholds are predeclared.

counterfactual_design_gates.label: Power, uncertainty, and sensitivity
counterfactual_design_gates.question: Precision, detectable effect, clustering, multiple testing, sensitivity, and uncertainty communication are explicit.

counterfactual_design_gates.label: Pre-registration, dual review, and propagation
counterfactual_design_gates.question: The design is frozen, independently reviewed, receipt-bound, and propagated before result inspection.
